```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
chart <- read_csv('ukhsa-chart-download2.csv')
gt(head(chart))
```
```{r}
ggplot(chart, aes(x= date, y=metric_value)) + geom_line(colour = 'red')
xlab("year")
ylab("DID")
```
